title: Student Support — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: From wellbeing to academics and finances, WCBT offers support services that help every student succeed and feel at home on campus.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

blocks.heading: Support that puts students first
paras: Confidential, caring, and accessible services designed around your needs throughout your studies.

blocks.heading: How we support you
paras: A range of services to keep you healthy, focused, and on track for success.

groups.title: Counselling Services
text: Confidential one-on-one counselling to help you navigate personal and academic challenges.

groups.title: Mental Health & Wellbeing
text: Wellbeing workshops, stress management, and resources to support your mental health.

groups.title: Academic Support
text: Tutoring, study skills, and guidance to help you stay on top of your coursework.

groups.title: Disability Services
text: Reasonable accommodations and inclusive support for students with disabilities.

groups.title: Financial Aid Advice
text: Guidance on scholarships, grants, and managing the cost of your education.

groups.title: Emergency Contacts
text: Know who to reach and how to get help quickly in urgent situations.

blocks.heading: Reach us when it matters
paras: If you or a fellow student needs urgent assistance, contact our support team right away.
Support is available during office hours. For after-hours emergencies, please contact local emergency services.

blocks.heading: Need to talk to someone?
paras: Our team is ready to help with counselling, academics, accessibility, or financial questions.
